biggest_catch: The friend must open their first eligible AUB checking account within 90 days of the referral email/text AND land $500+ in qualifying direct deposits within 60 days of opening - wire transfers, P2P, and transfers between your own accounts don't count.
catches: Referrer: 18+ with an active AUB personal checking account; register at the AUB Referral Center and submit valid email + phone for yourself and each referral.
Referrer earns a $100 cash bonus for each Individual or Business referred who fulfills the requirements.
Cap: $500 per calendar year per referrer; only the first referrer of each person/business is eligible.

Friend (individual): open first new eligible personal checking within 90 days of the referral email/text; receive qualifying direct deposits totaling $500+ within 60 days of account opening; must not have owned/co-owned an AUB personal checking in the last 12 months.
Friend (business): open first new eligible business checking and maintain $1,000+ average balance over the first two statement periods.
Bonus deposited into the AUB checking account 4-6 weeks after all conditions are met; account must be open and in good standing at payout; valid US Taxpayer ID required.
Bonus reported to the IRS as interest on Form 1099-INT.
Plus a $5 Starbucks Card for every 10 referrals (limit 5/year) - a separate kicker.
AUB can revoke, restrict, or change the offer at any time; disclosure effective 8/03/2026.
